args.query: SELECT * FROM inventory; SELECT * FROM consumption;

-- Assuming we can combine results to create a CSV for the purchasing team, execute a SELECT statement that joins the required tables and flags reorder quantities.
SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.current_stock, c.last_consumed, 
       (c.minimum_required - i.current_stock) AS reorder_quantity 
FROM inventory i JOIN consumption c ON i.item_id = c.item_id
WHERE (c.minimum_required - i.current_stock) > 0;

-- Assuming we have a function to export query results to CSV
EXPORT TO '/workspace/exports/consolidated_reorder.csv' FROM (SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.current_stock, c.last_consumed, 
       (c.minimum_required - i.current_stock) AS reorder_quantity 
FROM inventory i JOIN consumption c ON i.item_id = c.item_id
WHERE (c.minimum_required - i.current_stock) > 0);
